title: Repeat while a rule is true
summary: PL/SQL: Repeat while a rule is true. Stop after 4.
introduction: WHILE checks its rule before each repetition. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Repeat while a rule is true with PL/SQL

blocks.text: Use an Oracle practice database and SQL Developer Run Script or SQL*Plus. Run the whole block, including SET SERVEROUTPUT ON and the final slash. The result shown is DBMS_OUTPUT text.
Repeat while a rule is true

blocks.title: Repeat while a rule is true

blocks.text: The loop writes n, then increases it. It stops once n becomes 4.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Update the counter so the loop can stop.
